"stat": "OK",
"response": {
"desc": "This is an example group",
"group_id": "DGBDKSSH37KSJ373JKSU",
"mobile_otp_enabled": false,
"name": "Example Group",
"push_enabled": false,
"sms_enabled": false,
"status": "active",
"voice_enabled": false
}

Retrieve information about a group. Note that this output does not include a list of
group members. To retrieve group members, use
/admin/v2/groups/[group_id]/users . Requires "Grant resource - Read" API
permission.
